fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. Watch the little word that opens verse 4, “because.” The writer says the commandments aren't burdensome “…because everyone born of God overcomes the world.” (1 John 5:4). I think the point is that a load feels different depending on who's carrying it, and someone born of God has already overcome the world, so what God asks doesn't crush them.

problems.problem: It still restates the reason and names faith without helping the baker understand how overcoming the world connects to the commandments not being burdensome.
